PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Diodes ● P-N Junction diodes and biasing. ● P-N Junction characteristics ● Types and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Physics of wind formation 4.2 Introduction to Rockets Page 12 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Physics of Wind Formation ● Wind patterns (polar easterlies, westerlies, horse l and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Rockets Page 12 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYSICS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
